hints.text: $f^{-1}$ is the UNDO machine. If $f$ adds 9, what does the undo machine do?
The undo machine subtracts $9$ from whatever it is given. Apply that to $20$ by working out $20 - 9$.
Subtracting gives $20 - 9 = 11$, so the value of $f^{-1}(20)$ is $11$.

explanation: The function $f$ adds $9$, so its inverse must subtract $9$ to get back to the starting number.
Apply the inverse to $20$ by subtracting $9$ from it: $f^{-1}(20) = 20 - 9 = 11$.
Check by going forward: $f(11) = 11 + 9 = 20$, so the answer $11$ really does undo $f$.
